title: SkillBridge: Cost-Aware Diagnosis and Repair of Cross-OS Compatibility Defects in Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2611.26256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly reuse executable capabilities through skills, but a skill that works on one OS may fail on another because OS assumptions are spread across guide text, scripts, metadata, install contracts, and local entrypoints. Diagnosing such failures by running every skill on every OS is expensive: many executions spend model tokens, runner time, and review effort before revealing whether the failure is truly OS-related. We present SkillBridge, a contract-based workflow with three stages: static analysis, dynamic validation, and repair. SkillBridge first screens 3,270 skill-target-OS cases, covering 1,090 skills across Linux, macOS, and Windows, to find OS-sensitive contract evidence. It then runs dynamic tasks and root-cause review on selected cases to confirm whether a failure is caused by an OS assumption, and repairs the contract field that caused the failure, such as guide text, package scripts, dependencies, or platfor

translated_title: SkillBridge：智能体技能中跨操作系统兼容性缺陷的成本感知诊断与修复
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地通过技能来复用可执行能力，但在一个操作系统上正常工作的技能在另一个操作系统上可能会失败，这是因为操作系统相关的假设分散在指南文本、脚本、元数据、安装契约和本地入口点之中。通过在每个操作系统上运行每个技能来诊断此类失败的成本非常高昂：许多执行会消耗模型 token、运行器时间和审查精力，之后才能揭示失败是否真的与操作系统相关。我们提出了 SkillBridge，这是一个基于契约的三阶段工作流：静态分析、动态验证和修复。SkillBridge 首先筛选 3,270 个技能-目标操作系统用例（涵盖 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 上的 1,090 个技能），以寻找对操作系统敏感的契约证据。随后在选定用例上运行动态任务并进行根因审查，以确认失败是否由操作系统假设引起，并修复导致失败的契约字段，例如指南文本、软件包脚本、依赖项或平台相关配置。
tldr: SkillBridge 提出了一种基于契约的三阶段工作流（静态分析、动态验证与修复），以低成本方式诊断并修复 LLM 智能体技能在跨操作系统场景下的兼容性缺陷。
en_tdlr: SkillBridge introduces a contract-based three-stage workflow (static analysis, dynamic validation, and repair) to cost-effectively diagnose and repair cross-OS compatibility defects in LLM agent skills.
